1 · PDF 2,3 页 · table1_entry1
+→

投料：N-methyl isatin 0.31 mmol，1 equiv；Et 3-Me-allenoate (source substituent notation) 1 equiv；1,8-diazabicyclo[5.4.0]undec-7-ene 1 equiv；acetonitrile 用量未提供

条件：r.t.，2 h，Ar；m_mecn

操作：同 A1。

结果：收率 18%（分离）

构型：allenoate 2 (R2=Et, R3=Me)：轴手性 fragment C=C=C；configuration unassigned；basis no axial descriptor in source；3a：原子手性 status relative stereochemistry shown by wedge/dash in Scheme 2; absolute configuration unassigned；构型归属 Source drawing specifies relative stereochemistry; 3a is described as a single diastereomer and 3ag was confirmed by X-ray, but no absolute configuration is assigned.
